description: Undoes the most recent schema change of a collection (or the given activity entry) when no data written since would be lost. Use it when the user wants to revert a field or collection change. Only call after showing the plan to the user and getting explicit confirmation.

activityId.description: Activity entry to undo; defaults to the most recent undoable one, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: undo_collection_change
title: Undo collection change
